comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
As many of you know, the Solar Barge can be used to reach Atlantis (when it is present on Maris server) after completing a series of quests. The Barge can be used for up to one week using the Master of Ancient Technologies title (unlocked by doing Atlantis Imperial Quests from Store Keeper) until Atlantis relocates itself on Monday, 10AM server time.

Once Atlantis moves, you can re-unlock the Solar Barge by doing 3 barge quests (located at: uwodbmirror.ivyro.net/eg/main.php?id=193&chp=128 ) to reopen Solar Barge use for the week.

However, there is a useful trick you may consider.

1. From the day before Atlantis moves up to Monday 9:59AM, you may equip the Master of Ancient Technologies title (if your nation unlocked it) and board the Solar Barge.
2. Set sail in the barge, then log out.
3. Wait for 10:01AM, to ensure Atlantis has moved.
4. Log in, and cancel trip barge.

You will be able to visit Atlantis by Barge via title or by using Lost Ancient Celestial Globe items for the rest of the week without having to do the barge unlock quests, or run into pirates camped outside of Atlantis.

Keep in mind, your nation's progress with Ancient Technology Research is necessary to keep the Master of Ancient Technologies title, so some nations (often Venice) may not be able to use this technique if enough cumulative ATR quests have not been performed.

And remember, Atlantis leaves on 8/2 -- Cheers, and great online voyaging to you.
